name: Cybernetic Hi-School
source:
You have been selected as one of the few lucky male pupils to go to the famous Cybernetic Hi-School. But before you can enroll, you must undergo three tests executed by fellow female pupils. As you finish a round, your examinator takes off some clothes, until they are entirely naked.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cybernetic-hi-school]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
你幸運地從眾多男生中脫穎而出，獲得了進入著名「電腦學園」就讀的資格。然而正式入學前，你必須通過三場由女學生擔任考官的測試。每完成一輪，考官便會脫下一些衣服，直到最後全身赤裸。

［引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cybernetic-hi-school]MobyGames[/url]］
